content: Agrippaye Paulosore hodde, "Tor nizor fokke hota hoibolla tore ejazot diya giye." Hetunot Paulose hat barai diyore nizor fokke ei hota hoiye,
"Oh badša Agrippa, Ihudi okkole ãre ze hosuri diye hinor berudde õnor sarme aijja ãi nizor fokke hota hoibar šuzug faiyore ãi nizore baggitta mone gorir,
has gori zehon Ihudi okkolor soledde niyom edde hitarar barabarir babute õnottu bala gori zana ase. Hetolla doijjo dori ãr hotagun funibolla ãi õnore meherbani gori foriyad gorir.
"Ihudi manuš okkol beggune zane, šoṛo hale loti ãr nizor dešor manuš okkol edde bade Zeruzalemor manuš okkole zane ãi ki bafe zibon haṛaiyi.
Hitara ãre bout din dori sine. Ar hitara issa gorile goba o di faribo, ze ãrar dórmiyo Foroši name ze hora dol ase, ãi he Foroši zibon haṛaiyi.
Ar ehon Allaye ãrar bafdada okkolor hãse ze wada goijjil hinor uwore aša goijji buli ãr bisar or.
Ãrar baro bongšor manuš okkole dine raite zan foran diyore Allar ebadot goijjede hisabe he wada furon oiya dekibolla he ašat ase. Badša sahab, ei ašar zoriya Ihudi okkole ãre hosurbon gorer.
Allaye morare zinda tuillede ei hota kiyolla tũwara honokiye iyanore biššaš lagede hendilla mone no goror?
"Ãi nize o mone goritam ze Nasarator Isar namor berudde zen zen gora za hin beggun ãttu o gora dorhar buli.
Ar ṭik hen ãi Zeruzalemot goijjilam. Ḍõr imamottu kemota faiyore ãi bout Isar uwore biššaši okkolore ziyolot ditam edde hitarare marifelaibar šomot hitarar berudde boṭ ditam.

Hitarare šasti dibolla ãi har sinagog okkolot zaitam ar Isar berudde hoibolla ãi hitarare zur goritam. Hitarar uwore ãttu eto rag aššil ze hitarare zulum goribolla ãi bidešor šohor okkolot foijjonto zaitam.
"Endilla ek bar ḍõr imamor hãsottu kemota edde hokum loi ãi Damaskus zair.
Badša sahab, hẽtte ṭaim onumanik dũijja, fõtot maze beilottuwaro ujjol ekkan fohor asmanottu ãi edde ãr fũwajja okkolor sairo ḍakottu zola šuru goijje.
Ãra beggune meṛit fori gilamboi. Ar Ibroni bašat ãre hodde ek abaz funni,

content.text: 'Saul, Saul, tui ãr uwore kiyolla zulum goror? Keṛa buwaiya laṛir mukot lati mariyore ki tui tor nizor hoti no goror ne?'

content: "Hetunot ãi fusar goridde, "Malik, õne honnuwa?"
"Malike hodde,

content.text: 'Ãi Isa, zar uwore tui zulum goror. Ehon uṭ, tor ṭengot bor diyore tiya. Šeba goroya edde goba doya hisabe tore loibolla ãi deha diyi, zin tui ãttu deikkos edde zin ãi tore dehaiyum he babute goba dibi.
Tor nizor manuš okkol edde Oihudi okkolor hatottu ãi tore uddar goriyum. Ãi tore hitarar heṛe defeṛair,

hitarar suk kuli dibolla edde andarottu fohorot, edde Šoitanor dokolottu Allar hãse firai anibolla, zene ãr uwore biššaš anonor zoriya hitara guna maf fa edde zarare Paki gora oiye hitarar butore itarar zaga o.'

content: "Etolla badša Agrippa, behostottu ze deha diye ãi hiyanor obaiddo no oi.

Zara Damaskusot ase foila hitarar hãse, tarfore zara Zeruzalemot edde fura Ehudiya elehat ase, hitarar hãse edde tarfore Oihudi okkolor hãse ãi tobolig goijji, ze hitarattu gunattu mon firai Allar mikka firon sa, edde hitarar haz harbare forman fa za ze hitara gunattu mon firaiye.
Etolla Ihudi okkole ãre dórmogóror butore dori marifelaito kušiš goijje.
Kintu Allaye ãre aijja foijjonto modot gori aiyer. Ar hetolla ãi eṛe tiyaiyore šoṛo ḍõr beggunor hãse goba dir. Nobi okkol edde Musaye zin goṭibo hoi giye hinor baire ãi hono kissu no hoir.
He hota oilde endilla, Mosittu duk šowa foribo edde hiba he foila zon ze morattu zinda uṛi zaiboi, hibar nizor zatir manuš okkolor hãse edde Oihudi okkolor hãse nuror hóbor gušona goribo."
Paulose endilla gori nizor foikka hota hodde ṭaimot Festuse hoito no diyore guzori hodde, "Paulos, tui fol oi giyosgoi. Tui beši fonna foijjosde hine tore fol banai felaiye."
Hetunot Paulose hodde: "Ijjotdar Festus, ãi fol no, ãi zin hoir hin soiyi edde lowazade hota.
Badšaye to ei babute zane. Ãi hibar loi kulasa gori har hota hoi fariyum. Ar ãi iyano zani, ze in okkolor hono kissu hibar sukor arguwale no fore, kiyollahoile ei goṭona okkol to gufone no o.
Badša Agrippa, õne ki nobi okkolor hota biššaš goro? Ãi zani õne goro."
Hetunot Agrippaye Paulosore hodde, "Tui ki eto baiṭṭa ṭaimot maze ãre Isayi banaibolla kušiš goror?"
Paulose hodde, "Ṭaim baṛi otóba lamba, ãi šude tũwalla duwa no gorir bolke beggunolla, zara aijja ãr hota fuinne hitara beggune zen ãr ḍoilla o, ei siyolgan sara."
Hetunot badša uiṭṭiye, hitar fũwati govarnar Festus edde Berenik, edde zara hitarar fũwati boiššil hitara beggun uṛi tiyaiye.
Tarfore hitara he górottu giyegoi edde ekzone ekzonore howa hoi šuru goijje,"Ei manušwaye moron šaza ba ziyol haṛibar laikka hono kissu no gore."
Agrippaye Festusore hodde, "Ei manušwaye zodi Romor badšar hãse afil no gorito, toile hitare eridiya zaito."
